lessons.title: John Hayden RSI 80/40 & 60/20 Range Rules
lessons.context: RSI behaves logarithmically with the highest price sensitivity in the 40-60 zone. It defines macro bull vs. bear market regimes.
lessons.rule: Bull Trend: RSI ranges 80/40 (finds support at 40 US, resistance at 80 UR; Avg Gain > Avg Loss). Bear Trend: RSI ranges 60/20 (finds resistance at 60 DS, support at 20 DR; Avg Loss > Avg Gain). Equilibrium midline is 50 MD. Violation of 40 in an uptrend or 60 in a downtrend signals the regime is in jeopardy from longer timeframe capital.
lessons.anti_pattern: Treating RSI > 70 as an automatic short or < 30 as an automatic long. In strong bull markets, RSI routinely travels into 70-80 and respects 40 support; shorting based on retail overbought assumptions leads to severe losses.

lessons.title: Momentum Discrepancy Reversal Points (MDRP)
lessons.context: Detects when shorter timeframe counter-trend traders overextend during pullbacks, confirming dominant trend continuation.
lessons.rule: Bullish MDRP: In an uptrend, RSI dips BELOW a prior RSI trough, but price remains HIGHER than the prior price trough (signals pullback exhaustion and impending rally continuation). Bearish MDRP: In a downtrend, RSI rallies ABOVE a prior RSI peak, but price remains LOWER than the prior price peak. Calculate upside/downside price objectives by projecting reference swing distance from the intervening close.
lessons.anti_pattern: Mistaking an MDRP for a trend reversal. Counter-trend momentum overextension in an established trend is a high-probability continuation signal for the higher timeframe.

lessons.title: RSI Dual Moving Average Crossover Formula
lessons.context: Custom ThinkScript/PineScript lower study plotting smoothed momentum shifts on RSI.
lessons.rule: Calculate RSI(14), Fast EMA(9) of RSI, and Slow WMA(45) of RSI. BuyForm trigger: rsi[1] < ema[1] and rsi[1] < wma[1] and rsi > ema and rsi > wma. SellForm trigger: rsi[1] > ema[1] and rsi[1] > wma[1] and rsi < ema and rsi < wma. Slow WMA(45) serves as dynamic support/resistance for RSI pullbacks.
lessons.anti_pattern: Entering crossovers when the moving averages are misaligned with price trend or failing to confirm with price EMAs.

lessons.title: Multi-Timeframe Trend Ribbon & 6-Chart Alignment
lessons.context: Distinguishes immediate momentum from structural macro regimes across 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1H, 4H grid.
lessons.rule: Momentum Band: EMA 8 & EMA 21 (Yellow). Structural Band: SMA 50 & SMA 200 (Blue, secular line in the sand). Confirmed Uptrend: Yellow Band stacked above Blue Band. Top-Down Alignment: Macro (4H/1H) establishes compass; Intermediate (30m/15m) confirms structure; Granular (5m/3m) executes timing. Never take short trades when 4H/Daily trend ribbon is expanding upwards.
lessons.anti_pattern: Counter-trend scalping on 1m/3m against expanding 1H/4H trend ribbons. Micro noise is invalidated by macro institutional capital.

lessons.title: Fibonacci Entry & Multi-Tier EMA Trimming Execution
lessons.context: Strategic entry on pullbacks rather than FOMO chasing, with scaled exits to lock in gains.
lessons.rule: Enter long on pullbacks to Fib 38.2% (strong), 50% (medium), or 61.8% (Golden Pocket) confluence near EMA 21. Stop-loss: tight 2-3 points below entry Fib. Scaled Trimming: Exit 1/4 when price crosses below EMA 8; exit 1/2 when price crosses below EMA 21; exit final 1/4 when price crosses below SMA 50. In established trend, reasonable long entry is the Fib level right above EMA 21.
lessons.anti_pattern: Chasing green candles with FOMO at highs without waiting for a Fibonacci pullback, or holding full position through EMA 8/21 breakdown without trimming.

lessons.title: 80/20 Traps & Choppy Market Magnet Scalps
lessons.context: Handling momentum exhaustion traps and sideways equilibrium ranges.
lessons.rule: Bull Trap Pattern: 0. RSI hits 80 at local high -> 1. Price pulls back on Fib -> 2. RSI makes multiple lows under RSI EMA 9 -> 3. Price bounces to previous high for trap resolution. Magnet Chop Scalp: When RSI hovers near 50 and EMAs compress flat, WMA 45 acts as a gravitational magnet. If RSI extends far from WMA 45, enter on crossover back over EMA 9 targeting the exact touch of WMA 45. Exit immediately upon touching WMA 45.
lessons.anti_pattern: Expecting trend continuation in a sideways market where RSI hovers at 50; failing to take profit at WMA 45 in chop results in immediate mean-reversion reversal.

lessons.title: Mark Douglas Probability Axioms & Consistency Protocol
lessons.context: Trading success is 80% psychology and 20% methodology. Eliminating fear through probability thinking.
lessons.rule: Embrace the 5 Fundamental Truths: 1. Anything can happen. 2. You don't need to know what happens next to make money. 3. There is a random distribution between wins and losses for any edge. 4. An edge is only a higher probability of one thing over another. 5. Every moment in the market is unique. Execute the 7 Principles of Consistency: objectively identify edges, predefine risk on EVERY trade, accept risk completely, act without hesitation, pay yourself as market makes money available, monitor error susceptibility, and never violate rules.
lessons.anti_pattern: Moving stop losses, revenge trading, or hesitating to enter a valid signal due to memory of past losses. Demanding the market conform to one's beliefs instead of making uncommitted probability assessments.

lessons.title: Python 3.11 F-String Backslash Compatibility
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Never use backslashes inside f-string expression blocks ({...}) to preserve compatibility with Python 3.10 and 3.11.
lessons.anti_pattern: f'{self._c("1;32", "Text with \' quote")}' causes SyntaxError in Python <3.12.

lessons.title: Web Server LAN Network Binding Invariant
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: To allow multi-device or mobile access over local Wi-Fi, the web daemon must bind to 0.0.0.0 via --network. Defaulting to 127.0.0.1 strictly rejects external network IP requests.
lessons.anti_pattern: Attempting to access http://<LAN_IP>:8765 when server is bound strictly to 127.0.0.1 resulting in Connection Refused.

lessons.title: Sensory Feedback & WCAG 2.1 AA Invariant
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: All modal dialogs must enforce focus trapping (Tab/Shift+Tab) and focus restoration on unmount. Audio chimes must provide visual captions via SoundCaptionHUD for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
lessons.anti_pattern: Playing audio sound effects without accompanying visual subtitles or captions in HUD, or allowing keyboard focus to bleed behind open modal dialogs.

lessons.title: The Butler Background Runner Invariant
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: All operations, sprints, suites, or benchmarks expected to take >10 seconds must be dispatched via 'bento bg run "<cmd>" --tag "<tag>"' so they appear in Kitchen Chefs (DaemonView) and preserve interactive responsiveness.
lessons.anti_pattern: Running long test suites or agent loops directly in interactive shell or agent context without registering them in Bento Butler background runner.

lessons.title: Strict Accessible Modal Focus Trapping
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: All modal dialogs must trap focus using useA11yModal, bind Escape key dismissal, and restore focus to trigger.
lessons.anti_pattern: Unbounded focus leaking to background inputs or missing role='dialog'.

lessons.title: Streaming Terminal DOM and Live Region Safety
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Cap streaming terminal buffers in DOM to last 300 lines and never apply aria-live to active log containers; use off-screen status regions instead.
lessons.anti_pattern: Unbounded log line arrays and aria-live='polite' on rapid stdout streams causing main-thread lockups.

lessons.title: Bento Density Engine & Compact Terminal Mode
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Support both Spacious (Juubako) and Compact (Nigiri) layout modes to accommodate split-terminal monitoring without layout breakage.
lessons.anti_pattern: Fixed high-padding tables and cards causing vertical scroll explosions on small viewports.

lessons.title: Defensive Frontend Telemetry & Storage Hydration
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Always guard optional telemetry arrays and validate item-level schema when hydrating from localStorage.
lessons.anti_pattern: Directly calling .join() on load_avg or assuming localStorage JSON is non-null.

lessons.title: Responsive Card Boundaries & Mobile Flex Wrapping
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: All dashboard card headers and tag lists must use flex-col sm:flex-row with flex-wrap, overflow-hidden, and break-words/break-all on code and identifiers to prevent mobile text truncation and viewport overflow.
lessons.anti_pattern: Using flex justify-between items-center with long monospace identifiers and non-wrapping tag chips that stretch cards beyond mobile viewports.

lessons.title: Constellation Category Containment & Mobile Viewport Shield
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: All dynamic category and tag pill containers must declare flex-wrap with whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 on pills, and root documents must enforce overflow-x: hidden to prevent lateral viewport panning and card boundary clipping on mobile.
lessons.anti_pattern: Unwrapped flex rows for dynamic items causing card expansion beyond 100vw, or omitting whitespace-nowrap causing mid-hyphen multi-line word breaks.

lessons.title: LAN Network Mode Authentication
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: When binding bento ui to 0.0.0.0 for LAN access, auto-generate a cryptographic token (secrets.token_urlsafe(24)) and enforce it on all /api/* routes. Print the token-bearing URL. Open browser with ?token= so the React frontend can persist it to localStorage via initAuthToken(). Loopback (127.0.0.1/::1) is always exempt from auth for desktop UX.
lessons.anti_pattern: Running bento ui --network without authentication exposes /api/bg/run (arbitrary shell execution) to any device on the local subnet — a critical RCE risk on shared Wi-Fi.

lessons.title: Frontend Auth Token Pattern
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Use a shared apiFetch() wrapper in web/src/utils/api.ts that reads X-Bento-Token from localStorage and injects it as a header on every fetch(). For EventSource (SSE), use authEventSourceUrl() to append ?token= to the URL since EventSource does not support custom headers. Call initAuthToken() on app mount to extract ?token= from the URL into localStorage.
lessons.anti_pattern: Never scatter raw fetch() calls across React components when auth is involved. Never skip auth on EventSource SSE endpoints just because they appear read-only.

lessons.title: bg_runner shell=False and Dangerous Pattern Guard
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: subprocess.Popen in background runners must use shlex.split() + shell=False, sanitize tags to [a-zA-Z0-9_-], and reject destructive commands before process spawning.
lessons.anti_pattern: subprocess.Popen(command, shell=True) with arbitrary user inputs allowing command injection.

lessons.title: Always-Mounted ARIA Live Regions
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: aria-live status and alert regions must remain permanently mounted in the DOM (using sr-only when empty) so assistive technology detects mutations. Never conditionally mount aria-live containers.
lessons.anti_pattern: Conditionally unmounting aria-live containers so screen readers fail to register mutation events.

lessons.title: DaemonView Modular Component Architecture
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Keep DaemonView as a thin orchestration shell (<120 lines). Decompose into TaskLaunchPanel, TaskTable, and LogDrawer, driven by dedicated hooks (useTaskLogs, useTaskActions, useCommandHistory, useLocalStorage).
lessons.anti_pattern: Consolidating task execution, table rendering, SSE log streaming, and dialog state into a single 800+ line God Component.

lessons.title: Atomic Batch Process Termination and Pin Protection
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Backend endpoints for process operations must support batch execution (/api/bg/kill-batch) and respect pin-preservation filters (skip_task_ids) at the filesystem storage layer to prevent race conditions and unintentional state loss.
lessons.anti_pattern: Iterating multiple individual kill HTTP requests sequentially from frontend clients or failing to pass pinned exclusion IDs to filesystem pruning routines.

lessons.title: Streaming Terminal Scroll Protection and Hotkey Ergonomics
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Interactive streaming terminal interfaces must decouple scroll state from incoming chunks: detect user scroll-up to pause disruptive scroll snapping, display a floating 'Scroll to latest' resume control, provide toggleable select-none line number gutters, and wire standard shortcuts (Cmd+F / Ctrl+F) to focus search inputs.
lessons.anti_pattern: Unconditionally calling scrollIntoView on every streaming chunk, forcing viewport snapping and preventing developers from inspecting historical log traces.

lessons.title: Multi-Faceted Order State Filtering and Pantry Ergonomics
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Background task monitors should provide multi-faceted filtering combining status filters (All, Simmering, Ready, Failed), dynamic tag aggregation, and free-text search. Finished tasks must display formatted relative timestamps alongside execution duration, and empty dashboard states must provide one-click curated pantry actions.
lessons.anti_pattern: Limiting task dashboards to flat un-filterable tables without relative temporal context or empty-state guidance.

lessons.title: Multi-Dimensional Filter Recovery and Empty State Diagnostics
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: When tabular dashboards filter out all rows via compound criteria (text search, status pills, tags), the empty-state UI must detail all active constraints and render a one-click 'Reset All Filters' escape hatch to prevent user confusion.
lessons.anti_pattern: Displaying generic 'No matching results' text that fails to indicate which specific filter eliminated the data, or failing to offer an all-filter reset action.

lessons.title: Inline Command Clipboard Ergonomics and Log Artifact Versioning
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Process monitoring rows must provide hover-activated one-click clipboard copying for truncated command strings, and downloaded log artifacts must append ISO collision-resistant timestamps to prevent overwrites in developer downloads folders.
lessons.anti_pattern: Truncating command strings without copy affordances or exporting static-named log files that collide on repeated downloads.

lessons.title: Terminal ANSI Parsing and Log Match Navigation
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Render streaming terminal output with zero-dependency ANSI parsing and keyboard-accessible match jumping (Enter/Shift+Enter) to guarantee instant incident triaging without third-party heavy terminal emulators.
lessons.anti_pattern: Rendering raw ANSI escape artifacts as gibberish or loading heavyweight xterm.js bundles in lightweight dashboard modals.

lessons.title: Daemon Historical Average Duration Estimation
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Derive running background task duration expectations by memoizing completed tasks indexed by command and tag, giving operators immediate telemetry context.
lessons.anti_pattern: Displaying only raw monotonic timers with zero indication of expected baseline completion windows.

lessons.title: Memory Tag Atomization and Pantry Category Hierarchy
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Always atomize joined comma-delimited tags into discrete tokens and tier them under high-level category compartments with frequency counters to avoid unbounded UI tag cloud explosions.
lessons.anti_pattern: Dumping 70+ un-split comma-joined tags into a flat wrapping flex container that degrades viewport layout and traps keyboard navigation.

lessons.title: Markdown Export Header and Prompt Injection Guard
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Strip newlines and carriage returns from user-supplied recipe titles and category metadata before persistence or export to prevent markdown header hijacking and indirect prompt injection into AGENTS.md.
lessons.anti_pattern: Interpolating un-sanitized multi-line title strings directly into markdown H2/H3 headings.

lessons.title: Responsive Container Alignment Invariant
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Every global header sub-strip and horizontal telemetry bar must nest its content inside the max-w-7xl mx-auto container grid to prevent unbounded full-width stretching and alignment breaks on wide monitors.
lessons.anti_pattern: Allowing header sub-strips to expand directly across 100vw while inner page tabs and main canvas are constrained inside max-w-7xl.

lessons.title: Horizontal Scroll Strip Trailing Clearance and Dynamic Edge Masks
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: In horizontal scroll containers with edge gradient masks, always add trailing clearance (at least 32px overscroll spacer) and dynamically toggle mask opacity (opacity-0 at boundaries) so the trailing interactive element is never occluded or blocked from touch swiping.
lessons.anti_pattern: Static CSS after: pseudo-element gradient overlays pinned to right-0 without trailing clearance, which permanently trap the last item under the fade and prevent further swiping.

lessons.title: Bi-Directional Tab Scroll Synchronization
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: In mobile responsive web apps with dual navigation layers (e.g. top scrollable tablist and bottom dock), always synchronize active tab state with scrollIntoView({ inline: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' }) so the active indicator remains in the viewport regardless of activation trigger.
lessons.anti_pattern: Updating active tab state without centering the active tab element in the scrollable tablist, leaving the top bar stranded off-screen.

lessons.title: Global Keydown Exclusion for Form Select Controls
lessons.context: Manual rule addition via bento memory CLI
lessons.rule: Global keyboard event listeners for numerical shortcuts or single-key navigation must always exclude SELECT elements and select parent containers, preventing keypresses intended for dropdown option jumping from triggering global view switches.
lessons.anti_pattern: Checking only INPUT and TEXTAREA tags in global keydown guards, which causes dropdown selection keys to inadvertently trigger global hotkeys.
